thread:
Elena (CSM): quick heads-up — NovaPay's usage jumped ~3x for the last 48h and projection shows they'll hit their soft quota in ~6 days. I want to coordinate a proactive comms plan (7-day notice + mitigation options) before they see hard throttles. Link to live notes: https://redwood.app/notes/nova-quota-plan :eyes:
Mike (Account Lead): thanks Elena. Any change in latency or errors tied to that spike? we should include operational context in the email so they don't freak out.
Ravi (Eng Oncall): small bump in 95p latency (from 220ms -> 310ms) and a handful of 5xx traces coincident with bursty requests. Root cause looks like KV-cache churn under high concurrency. Mitigations: enable prefix KV caching for their keyspace (low-risk), and we can add a temporary burst policy for next 7 days.
Jenny (RevOps): projection from billing: estimated monthly spend +46% if current rate holds. Ops suggestion: offer a one-time 10% usage credit or short-term burst allocation to smooth renewal risk? also we should include a link to cost-control docs.
Elena (CSM): proposed comms items: 1) 7-day heads-up email, 2) suggested app-level optimizations (prefix caching, reduce max_tokens, use cheaper model if acceptable), 3) offer 72h temporary burst or credit, 4) ask if they'd like an enablement call. Draft below. thoughts? :point_down:
Sofia (Legal): high-level fine with wording as long as we avoid language that implies SLA breach or guaranteed mitigation. Keep it advisory and offer options.
Mike (Account Lead): copy me on the email. Also flag: if they accept burst, we need a quick ops ticket to provision. Ravi can you own that?
Ravi (Eng Oncall): I can handle provisioning and flip prefix caching for them (low risk). Will need the team's approval for increasing burst for >100k tokens/hr. Ping me when email goes out.
QuotaBot: NovaPay projected to hit 90% of soft quota on 1772900000 (in ~6 days). Automating soft-quota notice if no manual comms sent.
Elena (CSM): draft email (please review):
```
Hi <Customer Team>,

We noticed increased activity from your account over the past 48 hours and expect you to reach your soft quota in about one week. To avoid any interruption, here are a few options we can offer: 

• 7-day temporary burst (no service interruption) — we can provision immediately for 72 hours.
• Quick performance tips — enable prefix caching, reduce max_tokens where possible, or route lower-critical traffic to a cheaper model.
• Credit option — a one-time usage credit to offset this spike.

If you’d like us to provision a temporary burst or schedule an enablement call, reply and we’ll take care of it.

Thanks,
Elena — Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
```
Jenny (RevOps): looks good. Add a short note about cost impact and a link to the usage dashboard. Also add: "no action required if you're okay with the increased spend" to keep tone low-friction.
Elena (CSM): updated draft pasted to the doc. Mike — I penciled a follow-up call for Thursday 10am PT if we don't hear back. Want me to run that by Sales?
Mike (Account Lead): yes please. I'll join. Also add an option to accept burst via a one-click link we can track (send from our portal).
Ravi (Eng Oncall): once they accept, I’ll schedule the burst and enable prefix caching. ETA to provision: ~15-30 minutes after request.
Sofia (Legal): approve the final copy. Keep the credit terms as "one-time reviewable credit".
Elena (CSM): perfect — I'll send the email from my account in ~30m and tag everyone. I'll post the sent copy here. :thumbsup:
Mike (Account Lead): :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng Oncall): thanks, will standby.
QuotaBot: Notifying #customer-success and scheduling follow-up check-in for 1772980000 (in 9 days).
